entries.comment:

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. a.6: medicines as referred to in article 1-1-B of the 'Geneesmiddelenwet' (Dutch 'Medicine Act') for which a marketing authorization as referred to in article 1, section III of that act has been granted or for which a marketing authorization is not required pursuant to article 40-3-A to G of that act; contraceptives; infusion fluids; kidney dialyses concentrates; and inhalation gases apparently intended for medical purposes.

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment:
Tabel I prov. a.7: veterinary medicines as referred to in the 'Wet dieren' (Dutch 'Animal Act'), which are used in or on the animal itself (in vivo use). 
Excluded: products that are necessary to make a diagnosis and that are applied to tissue or body fluids originating from animals (in vitro use) are excluded; products that are used in the animal's living environment.
